integrity: The attached executable independently reproduces the finite graph and homology-displacement counts. Review is self-review only, not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the unit-edge Paley-13 flag torus only; does not give arbitrary-length cycle or general cyclic-torus classification. Bibliographic coverage of unindexed regular maps remains a risk.
title: Systolic four-cycles and affine homology action of the Paley-13 flag torus
